name: chipmate
description: Local VS Code coding agent runtime with OpenAI-compatible models, skills, and workspace tools.

chipmate.chat.apiBaseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL for ChipMate chat, for example http://localhost:8000/v1.

chipmate.chat.model.description: OpenAI-compatible chat model used by the ChipMate agent runtime.

chipmate.chat.maxTokens.description: Maximum generated tokens for ChipMate chat responses.

chipmate.chat.topP.description: Top-p nucleus sampling value for ChipMate chat responses.

chipmate.chat.streaming.description: Stream ChipMate chat responses when the provider supports OpenAI-compatible streaming.

chipmate.defaultModel.description: Optional fallback model used when a more specific ChipMate model setting is empty.

chipmate.skills.catalogUrl.description: Offline HTTP catalog URL for downloadable ChipMate skills and MCP packages.

chipmate.permissions.profile.description: Permission profile for ChipMate workspace writes, shell commands, skill scripts, and MCP tools.

chipmate.context.maxFileBytes.description: Maximum text bytes to include per local file context.

chipmate.context.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of local files to include in one request.

chipmate.context.includeDiagnostics.description: Include VS Code diagnostics in chat context by default.

chipmate.context.includeGitDiff.description: Include git diff in chat context by default.

chipmate.context.localOnlyMode.description: Prefer VS Code supplied local context and warn/block file questions when no local file content was captured.

chipmate.context.strictLocalOnlyAgent.description: Retained local-context safety setting for existing QA flow behavior.

chipmate.completion.provider.description: Provider for inline completions. ChipMate currently supports OpenAI-compatible direct models.

chipmate.completion.profile.description: Direct model completion profile. Generic Chat uses /chat/completions; Qwen Coder FIM uses raw /completions with Qwen fill-in-the-middle tokens.

chipmate.completion.apiBaseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL for direct inline completions. Falls back to chipmate.chat.apiBaseUrl when empty.

chipmate.completion.model.description: Optional direct inline completion model. Falls back to chipmate.chat.model or chipmate.defaultModel when empty.

chipmate.completion.maxTokens.description: Maximum generated tokens for direct inline completions.

chipmate.completion.topP.description: Top-p nucleus sampling value for direct inline completions.

chipmate.completion.debounceMs.description: Debounce time before requesting inline completions.

chipmate.completion.logLevel.description: Output logging level for ChipMate inline completions.

chipmate.completion.debugFullRetrievalPr.description: Debug only: for comment-guided C inline completion, disable retrieval timeout and dump full retrieval/projection candidates under .completion-quality/live-retrieval-debug.

chipmate.completion.debugExpectedSymbol.description: Debug only: symbol name to mark in comment-guided full retrieval dumps. This marker is not used for ranking, prompting, or rejection.

chipmate.completion.commentGuidedRetriev.description: Retrieval path for C/C++ comment-guided inline completion. qa-exact reuses the QA-style evidence query before projecting concise FIM context; completion keeps the completion-specific query.

chipmate.codeGraph.enabled.description: Automatically enable local C/C++ code graph indexing.

chipmate.codeGraph.promptOnWorkspaceOpen.description: Prompt or auto-index when a workspace opens, depending on current code graph state.

chipmate.codeGraph.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of C/C++ files to index in the local code graph.

chipmate.codeGraph.maxContextBytes.description: Maximum bytes of local code graph context to include in one prompt.

chipmate.codeGraph.maxEvidenceBytes.description: Maximum bytes of retrieved local code evidence to include in one prompt.

chipmate.codeGraph.maxGraphDepth.description: Maximum caller/callee graph depth for local code graph retrieval.

chipmate.codeGraph.maxFanout.description: Maximum relation fanout per graph expansion step for local code graph retrieval.

chipmate.codeGraph.maxDeepFiles.description: Maximum candidate files to inspect in a deep local code graph analysis pass.

chipmate.codeGraph.maxStateTransitions.description: Maximum state transitions to include in a local state-machine evidence pass.

chipmate.codeGraph.watcherRescanThreshol.description: Number of queued file watcher events that switches incremental indexing to one scheduled full rescan.

chipmate.codeGraph.workerConcurrency.description: Target concurrency for local analysis worker batches and benchmark planning.

chipmate.codeGraph.queryCacheSize.description: Maximum number of hot local code graph query contexts to keep in memory.

chipmate.codeGraph.memoryLimitMb.description: Soft heap limit for local code graph indexing.

chipmate.codeGraph.compileCommandsPath.description: Optional path to compile_commands.json for semantic C/C++ code graph analysis.

chipmate.codeGraph.clangdPath.description: Optional path to clangd on the workspace host for semantic C/C++ code graph analysis.

chipmate.codeGraph.scipClangPath.description: Optional path to scip-clang on the workspace host for semantic C/C++ code graph analysis.

chipmate.codeGraph.excludeGlobs.description: Additional VS Code glob patterns to exclude from local code graph indexing.

chipmate.analysis.bridge.enabled.description: Reserved for future local analysis tool bridge support. ChipMate agent tools do not require this bridge.

chipmate.analysis.maxEvidenceItems.description: Maximum evidence item count returned by local analysis tools.

chipmate.analysis.maxEvidenceBytes.description: Maximum evidence bytes returned by local analysis tools and evidence packs.

chipmate.analysis.maxFileSliceBytes.description: Maximum bytes returned from one local file slice analysis call.

chipmate.analysis.maxGraphEdges.description: Maximum graph edges returned by local callers, callees, call-chain, and state-machine analysis.

chipmate.analysis.maxPaths.description: Maximum state-machine or call-chain paths returned by local analysis tools.

chipmate.rag.embedding.endpoint.description: Full localhost or intranet embedding endpoint. OpenAI-compatible /v1/embeddings responses are expected.

chipmate.rag.embedding.model.description: Embedding model name sent to the local or intranet embedding endpoint.

chipmate.rag.embedding.batchSize.description: Number of RAG chunks embedded per HTTP request.

chipmate.rag.embedding.maxTokensPerReque.description: Estimated maximum embedding tokens sent in one RAG embedding HTTP request.

chipmate.rag.embedding.concurrentRequest.description: Initial maximum concurrent embedding requests during RAG indexing.

chipmate.rag.embedding.maxInFlightTokens.description: Approximate maximum embedding input tokens across in-flight RAG embedding requests.

chipmate.rag.embedding.checkpointMode.description: How often RAG embedding indexing writes recoverable partial checkpoints before the final index save.

chipmate.rag.embedding.checkpointChunkIn.description: Number of newly embedded chunks between partial RAG checkpoint saves.

chipmate.rag.embedding.checkpointInterva.description: Milliseconds between partial RAG checkpoint saves.

chipmate.rag.embedding.timeoutMs.description: Timeout for one embedding HTTP request.
chipmate.rag.embedding.timeoutMs.deprecationMessage: RAG embedding timeout is managed automatically from batch size.

chipmate.rag.embedding.requestDelayMs.description: Optional delay before starting the next RAG embedding HTTP request.

chipmate.rag.embedding.maxRequestsPerRun.description: Maximum embedding HTTP requests used by one RAG index run. Set to 0 for unlimited requests.

chipmate.rag.embedding.maxRetries.description: Maximum retry attempts for one RAG embedding batch when the provider returns 429 or 503.

chipmate.rag.embedding.retryBackoffMs.description: Base exponential backoff delay used when a rate-limited embedding response has no Retry-After header.

chipmate.rag.embedding.resumeAutomatical.description: Automatically resume paused RAG embedding index runs in the background until pending chunks are complete.

chipmate.rag.embedding.resumeDelayMs.description: Delay before automatically resuming a paused RAG embedding index run after the per-run request budget is reached.

chipmate.rag.rerank.endpoint.description: Full localhost or intranet rerank endpoint accepting query, documents, and top_n.

chipmate.rag.rerank.model.description: Rerank model name sent to the local or intranet rerank endpoint.

chipmate.rag.allowedHosts.description: Additional intranet hostnames allowed for embedding and rerank endpoints.

chipmate.rag.vectorTopK.description: Maximum vector candidates added to each hybrid RAG query.

chipmate.rag.rerankTopK.description: Maximum non-strong evidence candidates sent to the optional rerank service.

scripts.compile: bun run check-types && bun run lint && tsc --project tsconfig.json
scripts.package: bun run check-types && bun run lint && tsc --project tsconfig.json
